title: PurpleAir Smoke Episode Exposure Hour
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=purpleair:aqi
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(aqi_us>100)) as smoke_hours by sensor _time
| where smoke_hours>0
| sort - smoke_hours
description: Uses PurpleAir AQI readings telemetry to monitor how many hours a day were affected by smoky air in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for exposure days that should influence ventilation choices, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest PurpleAir AQI readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how many hours a day were affected by smoky air so you can spot exposure days that should influence ventilation choices before it becomes annoying.
